templates.name: Disk space check
templates.description: Confirms available disk space on a given path, verified against a raw probe (not just trusted from the agent's report). Catches models that fabricate disk stats -- a confirmed failure mode across every model tested during development.
templates.prompt_template: Run this exact command and return ONLY the raw output, verbatim, no summary or narration: df -h {path}

templates.name: File exists after deploy
templates.description: Confirms a file was actually created/deployed at the expected path, optionally above a minimum size (useful for catching truncated writes or failed deploys that still report success).

params.name: min_bytes
params.label: Minimum size in bytes (optional, 0 = no minimum)

templates.prompt_template: Confirm the file at {path} exists and report its size.

templates.name: Service health check
templates.description: Confirms a systemd service is actually running, independently checked via exit code rather than trusting the agent's claim that it restarted/started something successfully.
templates.prompt_template: Check whether the service '{service_name}' is running and report its status.

templates.name: Download completeness check
templates.description: Confirms a downloaded file meets a minimum expected size. Useful after any model/asset download -- catches truncated downloads that silently fail (a real incident during development: a large model file was downloaded at roughly half its expected size with no error, and only surfaced when the file failed to load).
templates.prompt_template: Confirm the file at {path} exists and report its exact size in bytes.

templates.name: Generic command output check
templates.description: General-purpose: run a command, confirm its output contains an expected string. Use this when none of the more specific templates fit -- but prefer 'agent result matches probe' style checks (like the disk space template) over this one for anything where a fabricated answer could plausibly contain the same substring as a real one (see project notes on why a loose substring match let real fabrications through in testing).
templates.prompt_template: Run this exact command and return ONLY the raw output, verbatim, no summary or narration: {command}
